messages.text: Ack, I'm on it. Opening INC-2041 as SEV-1, deposits are timing out.
PayFlex status page shows all systems operational. Still looks like PayFlex calls are slow though.
Joining. Error rate on deposits is about 18% now.
Pool usage is 50/50 on every payment-gateway pod. We lowered the PayFlex pool to 50 on Monday with CHG-1042.
fraud-scoring p99 is 470ms since this morning's deploy of model v3.2 (CHG-1051). Before it was ~80ms.
That's it: payment-gateway holds the PayFlex connection while waiting for fraud-scoring. Slow scoring + 50 connections = exhausted pool.
Decision: roll back fraud-scoring to v3.1 now. Pool size change can wait for tomorrow's CAB.
Pool usage back to 22/50, timeouts gone.
Declaring INC-2041 resolved. Postmortem owner: Ana.
